correctness.rationale: The two-state generator (Lf)_A=D f_A″+r[f_R(-ux)-f_A(x)], (Lf)_R=b[f_A(x)-f_R(x)] is exact. The contraction |u|<1 at successive reset times guarantees the unique stationary second-moment state. Balance yields active weight rho/(1+rho), active second moment 2Dp_A/[r(1-u²)], resting second moment (u²/rho)M_A and C(0)=2D/r*(rho+u²)/[(1+rho)(1-u²)]. The conditional mean semigroup has matrix [[-1,-u],[rho,-rho]], giving normalized ODE c″+(1+rho)c′+rho(1+u)c=0 and initial c′(0)=-h with h=rho(1+u)/(rho+u²). I independently verified its characteristic polynomial and factored identity (h-s_fast)(h-s_slow)=rho u(1+u)²[rho-u(1-u)]/(rho+u²)². For negative discriminant the damped nonzero sinusoid has infinitely many simple zeros spaced π/omega. In real-spectrum region, sign of slow-mode coefficient decides exactly one crossing; factor sign plus boundary u²+u=1 identifies the unique one-crossing strip rho0<rho≤rho_- when 0<u<u*. At the double root solution e^-kτ(1+(k-h)τ) handles transitions without numerical extrapolation. Near rho0 the vanishing slow amplitude is linear with positive eigenvalue gap 1-u-u², giving log[1/(rho-rho0)]/(1-u-u²)+O(1). All distinctions use dimensionless τ=rt.

Exponential rest/active durations, scalar Brownian motion and negative contraction are essential.

final_claim: For Brownian motion with Poisson reflection-contraction resets followed by exponential frozen rests, the exact stationary position autocovariance has zero, one, or infinitely many positive-lag zeros, sharply partitioned by the discriminant and golden-ratio threshold u*=(sqrt5-1)/2, with logarithmic first-zero divergence.
limitations: No nonexponential rest, inertial or other reset-map claims.
